segments.name: Rockland Trust
products: Mobile, online, and telephone banking services
segments.description: A Massachusetts trust company providing banking, investment and financial services to businesses and consumers in Eastern Massachusetts, Worcester County, southern New Hampshire, and Rhode Island.
segments.evidence: At December 31, 2025, Independent Bank Corp.'s consolidated subsidiaries included the Company's banking subsidiary, Rockland Trust, which is the Company's only reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns interest income from borrowers on its commercial, consumer real estate, and other consumer loan portfolios, and also generates non-interest income from banking, investment, and financial services.
